summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed SPAC (COLAU/COLA/COLAR), filed an 8-K reporting successive adjournments of its Extraordinary General Meeting, most recently to 9:30 a.m. ET on September 30, 2026, at Loeb & Loeb LLP, without submitting proposals to a vote. The pending proposal is approval of the business combination with WISeSat.Space Corp, per the definitive proxy filed August 19, 2026. Record date remains August 17, 2026. Watch redemption levels, quorum and vote outcomes, and extension dynamics as deal-certainty signals.
